concept: Compute Optimizer: rightsizing by actual utilization
tests: Which service gives rightsizing recommendations for underutilized EC2.
expected: AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization metrics and recommends optimal instance types/sizes. Triggers: "idle and underutilized", "recommendations to right-size", "reduce cost".
why_not: Inspector is vulnerabilities; Config is configuration state; CloudWatch alarms alert but don't recommend sizes.
